name: antigravity-booster
description: Parallel multi-agent fleet orchestrator for Google Antigravity: compiles specs into ticket DAGs, dispatches isolated git-worktree builders across Gemini and Claude/GPT quota pools, and enforces ADLC frozen rails and cross-model diff prosecution.
suggestedPrompts: Run /agb to plan, execute, or review a multi-agent build across Gemini and Claude/GPT quota pools.
Use /agb-plan to compile my specification into a dependency-ordered ticket DAG with frozen rails.
Run /agb-review on my current branch to prosecute the diff across correctness, security, tests, and contracts.
author: Chris Williams
